### Roadkill (2020) — Power, Secrets & The Consequences of Betrayal 🔥

Roadkill is a political thriller starring Hugh Laurie as Peter Laurence, an ambitious British politician whose career is built on confidence, influence, and an ability to survive controversy. As he rises through the political world, Peter appears determined to secure greater power, but his carefully managed public image hides secrets that threaten to destroy everything he has worked for.

As scandals emerge and personal enemies begin closing in, Peter faces growing pressure from the media, his political rivals, and the people closest to him. Each revelation creates new problems, forcing him to make difficult choices while protecting his reputation. The more he tries to control the situation, the more complicated his life becomes.

The series explores ambition, corruption, family secrets, manipulation, and the price of power. It reveals how the desire to succeed can push people into dangerous compromises and how even the most influential figures can struggle to escape the consequences of their past.

What makes Roadkill compelling is its portrayal of a man determined to stay on top while everything around him threatens to collapse. In a world where appearances matter and loyalty can disappear overnight, survival becomes a game of strategy.

💬 “Power can open every door, but it cannot keep the truth from coming out.”
